Digital delivery policy

The Free button opens our official itch.io page. Choose the available Windows file to begin downloading. Delivery is through the browser; download time depends on file size, connection speed and platform availability. No email delivery is promised.

Plus for Windows and the Plus mobile room are coming soon. There is currently no paid download, activation key or delivery commitment. The ₹99 display is a planned price only, and no pre-orders are accepted.

If a download or installation fails

Check your internet connection and free storage, and retry from the official page. Review the supported devices and installation notes. If Windows blocks an unsigned installer, contact us rather than disabling security.

Send the file name, operating system and error message to support. Keep your save backups separate from installers.
